description: Why am I running for Wisconsin State Assembly District 53? I want District 53 to have someone there who approaches those problems the same way I've approached them here at home. Not by deciding what the answer is before asking the question. Not by checking which political party introduced the idea. And being able to come with the understanding that disagreements doesn't make someone is the enemy.
